children: China's emergency management ministry said on Friday that direct economic losses incurred from natural disasters in August amounted to 36.03 billion yuan ($5.38 billion).
The authorities counted 595 people who have died or disappeared in natural disasters, and a total of 12.62 million people and 857.4 thousand hectares of crops affected.
